data.long_meaning: Gomateshwar is a name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Goma’ meaning ‘earth’ and ‘Ishwar’ meaning ‘lord’. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as ‘Gomateshwar’ or ‘Lord of the Earth’. The name signifies the deep connection between the divine and the earth, and the reverence for the earth as a source of life and nourishment.
